testimonials.intro: Students from around the world share their experience at Lumièrebourg University City.

row1.author: Amara Diallo
row1.quote: Lumièrebourg gave me real friendships and a network I still use. The team actually responds when you need them.

row1.author: Théo Marchand
row1.quote: The common spaces are really designed for working and relaxing. I met my best friends here during cultural evenings organized by the city.

row1.author: Yuki Nakamura
row1.quote: As an international student, Lumièrebourg made my integration in Paris incredibly easy. Administration speaks several languages and procedures are simple.

row1.author: Léa Fontaine
row1.quote: The room is better than I expected for what I pay. The fiber connection is solid too, which matters a lot for design work.

row1.author: Ibrahim Koné
row1.quote: Two years at Lumièrebourg and I don't regret a single day. Maintenance requests are handled in less than 48 hours - it really changes daily life.

row2.author: Camille Rousseau
row2.quote: The online application process is really well designed. In a few clicks, I had secured my room. A real time-saver during a stressful period.

row2.author: Omar Benali
row2.quote: I met students from over 30 countries here. Not something you expect from student housing, and it genuinely changed how I think.

row2.author: Sofia Petrov
row2.quote: Quiet enough to actually study, close enough to central Paris to have a life outside. That combination is genuinely hard to find.

row2.author: Antoine Lebrun
row2.quote: Renewing your lease online is surprisingly simple. You get reminders, sign electronically - never had to make unnecessary trips.

row2.author: Priya Sharma
row2.quote: It works when it needs to, and it's actually fun the rest of the time. Tell everyone you know.
